<function name="DrawArrow" parent="DTooltip" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Used to draw a triangle beneath the <page>DTooltip</page>
<note>Requires <page>DTooltip:SetContents</page>, without this it will error</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="x" type="number">arrow location on the x axis</arg>
		<arg name="y" type="number">arrow location on the y axis</arg>
	</args>
</function>
